messages:
sanjay: Heads-up — Datadog asked about a joint showcase for HW partners to surface LLM tracing in their marketplace tile. They want to show model-level spans + GPU metrics together. Anyone got quick wins we can demo?

elena: Nice. We should highlight the OTLP collector + our prefix/KV cache tagging. Keep it simple: trace -> span metadata -> link to infra metrics dashboard.

mike: From eng-obs POV, easiest demo is: instrument runtime to emit trace/span for inference shard + attach tags: model, seq_len, quant_profile, gpu_id. Then Datadog can correlate with GPU metrics via host tags.

jordan: I can build a sample dashboard panel that joins traces and GPU metrics via `model` tag. Will need sample traces and a prometheus exporter for gpu_util.

sanjay: Perfect. Datadog asked for an example OTEL config. Mike — can you sketch the exporter snippet?

mike: Yup. Pasting a minimal config we use internally:

```yaml
exporters:
  otlp/datadog:
    endpoint: "otlp.datadoghq.com:4317"
    headers:
      dd-api-key: "$DD_API_KEY"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [otlp/datadog]
```

mike: Also add attributes we emit: `model.name`, `model.version`, `inference.latency_ms`, `gpu_id`, `batch_size`. Datadog can use those for grouping.

elena: For the marketplace tile, marketing wants a one-pager: value prop, screenshot, and minimal install flow (1-2 commands). Jordan — can you create a demo run that does `curl` to our hosted endpoint and shows the trace + dashboard?

jordan: On it. I'll wire a small script that: hit /v1/generate, capture trace id, then link to the datadog trace view + dashboard url.

obs-bot: deploy-bot: New private demo cluster deployed for `partnerships/demo-otel` (cluster-id: c-9a1f).

sanjay: Great timing. Elena — want to sync with Datadog PM (maria) and HW partner lead (luca) tomorrow? Quick 30m to agree scope and announcement cadence.

elena: Yes — I'm blocking 30m in maria's calendar for 10:30 PT. I'll add agenda: demo assets, tile listing checklist, co-branded screenshot.

mike: For the HW side, we should call out node-exporter labels for GPU family (A100/V100/RTX). That helps partners see perf delta. Also include a note on quantization artifacts we observed when correlating traces with perf regressions.

jordan: I'll add a note in the dashboard doc about alert rules: `inference.latency_ms > 150` for P50 -> pager to integrations-squad.

sanjay: Action items: elena -> sync PMs; mike -> provide sample OTEL config + example traces by EOD; jordan -> demo dashboard + curl script by EOD; elena -> draft one-pager after sync.

elena: ack. tagging: @maria (Datadog PM) and @luca (HW lead) in the meeting invite.

mike: pinging infra to ensure the demo cluster has GPU metric exporter enabled.

sanjay: Thanks folks. If we get this right, it's a nice GTM piece: marketplace tile + joint blog + partner webinar. :rocket:

jordan: :thumbsup:

elena: Will update here after the sync.
